faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about using Auto Crónica to check out a car's problems before you buy.

whatIs.question: What is Auto Crónica?
whatIs.answer: It's a catalog of chronic problems, organized by make, model, year and engine. It brings together in one place what typically breaks on each car, how serious it is, around what mileage it shows up and how to fix it, info that's usually scattered across forums, groups and videos.

howToSearch.question: How do I look up a car's problems?
howToSearch.answer: On the home page, enter the make, model, year, engine and fuel type (number of doors is optional) and click "Search faults". You can also check out the Defects section, which lists the most reported problems by make and model.

sources.question: Where does the information come from?
sources.answer: From owner reports and a selection of technical sources. When there isn't enough data on a car yet, an AI flags the most likely problems, and that content is always labeled as AI-generated. Over time, the community comments, corrects and votes to make everything more reliable.

mechanic.question: Can I skip the pre-purchase inspection?
mechanic.answer: No. The results are for reference only and help you walk into a purchase or a service appointment better informed. Before you close the deal, always have the car checked out by a mechanic you trust.

severity.question: What do the severity levels mean?
severity.answer: Each problem is rated Low, Medium, High or Critical, based on how much it impacts safety, reliability and repair cost. When available, we also show the mileage where the problem usually shows up and the known fixes, step by step.

account.question: Do I need an account? Is it free?
account.answer: Searching is free and no account is required. Signing in with Google lets you save cars to your garage, follow favorites, post comments and vote on fixes. The project is independent and runs on donations.

garageVsFavorites.question: What's the difference between Garage and Favorites?
garageVsFavorites.answer: Your Garage is for the cars you own: it gives you a quick look at each one's known issues. Favorites let you keep tabs on cars you're thinking about buying or are just interested in.

contribute.question: How can I pitch in?
contribute.answer: Comment on a problem with your own experience, including photos of the repair, and vote for the fixes that worked for you. If the project has helped you out, you can also support it with a donation on the Support page.
